scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from exact lattice-vector rank thresholds and a parity-character lattice-point count. Finite exact tests are corroborative; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete for axis-aligned boxes relative to the even-coordinate-sum lattice only. No general corrected inequality for arbitrary symmetric bodies is claimed. The literature comparison cannot certify universal historical priority.
title: Exact parity defect and failure intervals for the symmetric lattice-point lower product on \(D_n\) boxes
